subsetPolicyRationale: `s.norm.din18599@1` is this plugin's own self-contained DIN V 18599 building-energy-balance document — there is no alternate conformance profile, encoding variant or standard subclass to split against: every mutation (change-use-class, specify-heating-system, update-ventilation, replace-zones, change-element-u, update-climate, …) reads and writes the SAME single value model this plugin owns, through the SAME codec/dispatch regardless of which field, record or nested collection it touches. `✳️any` remains this artifact's only real scope.
